@G = external global i1
@G.1 = external global i1
@G.2 = external global i8

define target("riscv.vector.tuple", <vscale x 16 x i8>, 3) @test_tuple_zero_non_power_of_2() {
entry:
  %A = alloca i1, align 1
  store i1 true, ptr %A, align 1
  %LGV3 = load i8, ptr @G.2, align 1
  %LGV = load i1, ptr @G, align 1
  switch i8 %LGV3, label %SW_D [
    i8 -115, label %SW_C
    i8 18, label %SW_C4
    i8 -124, label %SW_C5
    i8 107, label %SW_C6
    i8 120, label %SW_C7
  ]

BB2:                                              ; preds = %SW_C7, %SW_C5, %SW_C4, %SW_C, %SW_D
  br i1 %LGV, label %T, label %F

BB:                                               ; preds = %F, %T
  ret target("riscv.vector.tuple", <vscale x 16 x i8>, 3) zeroinitializer

T:                                                ; preds = %BB2
  br label %BB

F:                                                ; preds = %F, %BB2
  %LGV1 = load i1, ptr @G.1, align 1
  br i1 %LGV1, label %F, label %BB

SW_D:                                             ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB2

SW_C:                                             ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB2

SW_C4:                                            ; preds = %SW_C4, %entry
  %L = load i1, ptr %A, align 1
  br i1 %L, label %SW_C4, label %BB2

SW_C5:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB2

SW_C6:                                            ; preds = %entry
  ret target("riscv.vector.tuple", <vscale x 16 x i8>, 3) poison

SW_C7:                                            ; preds = %entry
  br label %BB2
}
